# Belan AI

> Belan AI is gamified SMS marketing for restaurants. Instead of blasting coupons, Belan texts customers a quick game — trivia, pick a number, roll the dice, closest guess, a random draw — and turns every reply into a real coupon that becomes a discount at the register. Owners see exactly which orders each campaign brought back.

## What We Do

1. **Gamified SMS campaigns** — Pick a game from a curated catalog (or build your own), set prizes and a schedule, test it on your own phone, and launch. Winners get the prize; everyone else can get a consolation discount. "Everyone wins" mode gives every player the prize.
2. **Promotional messages** — One-off or scheduled texts to any group of customers, with an optional instant coupon.
3. **Branded coupon pages** — Each coupon link opens a page in the restaurant's own branding (logo, colour, food photo) and creates a real POS discount when redeemed. Link previews carry the restaurant's branding too.
4. **Referrals and sign-up links** — Customers can invite a friend for a bump on their own coupon; a QR-code web form lets new customers join the text list with proper consent.
5. **Revenue tracking** — Orders that used a coupon are pulled from the POS and attributed to the campaign.
6. **Customer timeline** — Every text, reply, game, coupon and POS order for a customer, in one searchable history.

## Also available (legacy products)

Voice AI phone ordering and SMS text ordering — see https://belan.tech/oldprods

## Pricing

$200 per month, flat. Includes a dedicated marketing phone number and unlimited campaigns. Branded RCS sender available for a $500/year carrier registration fee.

## POS Integrations

Clover today; Toast and Square in progress.
